# Heather Fernstrom

> Heather Fernstrom Border is the co-founder and Managing Partner of Alliance Global Advisors, an institutional real asset investment advisory firm. She has more than 20 years of experience in real estate, has advised on over $520 billion in assets under management, and has been recognized on the Inc. Female Founders 500 (2026), as a four-time Inc. 5000 honoree (four consecutive years), and on the cover of Inc. Magazine's "10 Most Empowering Women in Business" (2024).

## Key facts

- **Full name:** Heather Fernstrom Border (also known as Heather Fernstrom)
- **Role:** Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Alliance Global Advisors (founded 2020)
- **Focus:** Institutional real estate and real asset investment advisory, investor relations (IR) platform development, capital formation, LP relationship building
- **Experience:** 20+ years in real estate; $520B+ in AUM advised
- **Location:** Florida, USA
- **Clients:** Real estate investment managers of all sizes, with a focus on emerging managers and MWBE / diverse-owned firms seeking institutional capital
- **Contact:** heathfern@gmail.com
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/heatherfernstrom/
